2.w: “Until when will you⁺ afflict my soul, and crush me with words?

3.w: These ten times you⁺ have reproached me; are you⁺ not ashamed [that] you⁺ have done wrong to me?

4.w: And if I have truly gone astray, my straying lodges with me.

5.w: If you⁺ would truly magnify [yourselves] over me and plead my reproach against me,

6.w: then know that God has wronged me and has thrown His net over me.

7.w: Behold, I cry out, ‘Violence!’ And I am not answered. I cry for help, [and] there is no justice.

8.w: My way He has walled off, and I cannot pass over; and upon my paths He has set darkness.

9.w: My honor He has stripped from me, and He has turned aside the crown from my head.

10.w: He tears me down round about and I depart, and He pulls out my hope like a tree.

11.w: And He has kindled against me His anger, and He reckons me for Himself among His adversaries.

12.w: His troops come as one, and they build up their ramp against me, and they encamp all around my tent.

13.w: My brothers He has put far from me, and my acquaintances surely are estranged from me.

14.w: Those near to me have ceased, and those known to me have forgotten me.

15.w: Those who sojourn in my house, and my maidservants, they reckon me as a stranger; I have become a foreigner in their eyes.

16.w: I call to my servant, and he does not answer; with my mouth I seek favor from him.

17.w: My breath is strange to my wife, and I am loathsome to the sons of my womb.

18.w: Even little boys despise me; I arise, and they speak against me.

19.w: All the men of my counsel abhor me; and those I love have turned against me.

20.w: My bone clings to my skin and to my flesh, and I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

21.w: Pity me, pity me, you⁺ my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

22.w: Why do you⁺ pursue me as God [does]? Are you⁺ not even satisfied with my flesh?

23.w: Who will grant now that my words should be written? Who will grant [that] they be inscribed in a book,

24.w: with a pen of iron and with lead, they would be engraved forever in the rock!

25.w: And I know [that] my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the dust.

26.w: And after they strike off my skin thus, yet in my flesh I will see God.

27.w: [He] whom I will see for myself, indeed my eyes will see, and not a stranger. My kidneys yearn in my bosom!

28.w: If you⁺ should say, ‘How we will pursue after him,’ and ‘The root of the matter is found with him,’

29.w: be afraid for yourselves of the face of the sword, for from wrath is the punishment of the sword, so that you⁺ may know [there is] a judgment.”
